page_prompt.title: Write your Fiverr gig in 2 minutes
page_prompt.summary: Gig title, description, 3 priced packages and tags, ready to edit
page_prompt.prompt: Write a Fiverr gig for [your skill] aimed at [your buyer]. Give me: 1) a search-friendly title starting with 'I will', 2) a 120-word description, 3) Basic, Standard and Premium packages with what's included and a price range, 4) 5 search tags, 5) 3 questions to ask buyers. I'm a [your level]. Say if you're unsure about Fiverr fees or rules.
page_prompt.then: Rewrite the description shorter and in a friendlier tone.
page_prompt.tip: Check Fiverr's current gig rules and fees before you publish.
